div.div:
Notes
*1 Four client tools
AWS CLI, s5cmd, rclone, and Mountpoint for Amazon S3. Their operations were checked on real hardware from an EC2 instance in ap-northeast-1 on 2026-11-24.
*2 Server-side copy stays in one Region
CopyObject and UploadPartCopy. Checked on real hardware with AWS CLI, s5cmd, and rclone. File attributes are not carried over.
*3 The AWS services at the lower right are expectations from documents
Not checked on real hardware in this repository.
